item.description:
Location: Qatar
Description:

A 3rd Engineer position is available for Nigerian nationals in Qatar. The role requires at least 5 years of seagoing experience, with a focus on routine engine maintenance, inspection, servicing of fuel and cooling systems, generator maintenance, and assisting with overhauls. Candidates must possess a valid Engineer Officer CoC, applicable STCW training, and medical fitness. The salary offered is QR5,000 – QR6,000, with free work permit, food, accommodation, and transport provided.

Description:

An experienced Marine Engineer is sought for a shore-based Technical Superintendent role overseeing the technical management, maintenance, and compliance of approximately five tankers. Requires a Class 1 Motor or Combined Chief Engineer CoC with recent experience on chemical or product tankers. Based in Lagos, Nigeria. Salary offered is ₦8,000,000 – ₦10,000,000 Monthly, negotiable.
